kunang_kelam: A firefly the size of a fist whose light is inverted: its abdomen emits a small orb of darkness with a faint violet rim, swallowing the light around it. Thin translucent wings, delicate legs.
boss_hampa_penjaga_hutan: A towering hollow woodcutter, grey skin like ash-bark, empty eye sockets leaking thin fog, still gripping a notched felling axe. Moss and broken lantern hooks hang from its shoulders; it moves like it forgot why it is chopping.
serigala_kabut: A lean wolf whose fur dissolves into drifting smoke at the edges, glowing amber eyes, low stalking pose, half of its hind body already fading into mist.
lumut_berjalan: A shambling mound of moss, roots and rotten wood that used to be a tree stump, small glowing fungus, root-legs dragging through the mud, two knots like sleepy eyes.
hampa_pengembara: A hollow villager with ash-grey skin and blank white eyes, wearing faded farmer clothes, still repeating the motion of an old chore with an empty basket. Sad, not monstrous.
buruan_kunang_raja: A firefly as big as a buffalo head, its glowing abdomen is not light but a hole shaped like light: a void with a burning violet edge. Huge compound eyes, ragged wings.
boss_raja_katak_lumpur: An enormous swamp frog king, bloated and ancient, skin like wet mud and moss, a crude crown of rusted lantern frames on its head. Its swollen belly glows from within with the lanterns it has swallowed.
katak_rawa_bengkak: A frog the size of a cart, swollen belly faintly glowing orange from a swallowed swamp lantern, warty mud-green skin, heavy lids, sitting in shallow water.
ikan_cermin: A flat, disc-shaped fish whose scales are tiny mirrors reflecting a distorted face of the viewer, fins like thin glass, floating above dark water.
nelayan_hampa: A hollow fisherman with ash-grey skin, conical woven hat, casting a torn net that trails fog, standing on a small bamboo raft, eyes blank and patient.
boss_ular_cermin: A serpent as long as a pier, coiled high, every scale a mirror showing the faces of people who once stared at it, eyes like two pale moons, water dripping from its coils.
buruan_nelayan_tenggelam: A drowned fisherman, twenty years under water: bloated grey skin, seaweed hair, yet holding a brand-new, bright fishing net. Water pours from his clothes.
bayang_arsip: A tall figure made of stacked scrolls, ledgers and dripping ink, pages fluttering like breath, a mouth of torn paper reciting names, ink trails on the floor.
pengawal_karat: An empty suit of rusted palace guard armor moving on its own, dented helmet with nothing inside, rust flaking, a notched spear, faint fog inside the joints.
kendi_ingatan: A knee-high earthen water jar walking on small clay legs, stopped with faded inked cloth, whispering light leaking from cracks, as if the contents are still talking.
boss_kapten_rangga: A stern human captain of the Crown Guard, in lacquered dark armor with a red sash and a long spear, scar across the cheek, disciplined stance, eyes afraid of chaos rather than enemies.
kelelawar_kristal: A bat whose wings grow shards of pale violet memory-glass, crystals clinking, sharp glowing eyes, hanging upside down in a cave.
perenang_dasar: A pale deep-water swimmer who went down to retrieve something and never decided to come up: long drifting hair, webbed hands, clutching a small box, bubbles rising.
serpih_cacat: A creature assembled from rejected shards of memory-glass fused into one angular, jagged body, facets reflecting broken scenes, glowing seams.
boss_juru_kaca_tenggelam: A drowned glass-miner in heavy work armor and a cracked diving helmet, dragging an iron chest on a chain, glass shards growing from his back, lantern dead at his belt.
buruan_zirah_tanpa_nama: A palace guard armor with no emblem, no name and no one inside, polished but anonymous, standing perfectly still with a curved blade, darkness in the visor slit.
penambang_terlupa: A huge hollow miner with a hunched back crusted with violet memory crystals, pickaxe dragging, headlamp long extinguished, ash-grey skin.
boss_penambang_raksasa: Several miners melted together into one giant mass, multiple arms holding pickaxes, faces half-merged, a back covered in large glowing memory crystals that change color.
pelita_padam: The remnant of an old Pelita: a dim, human-shaped figure of faded light, edges flickering like a dying lamp flame, hollow where the heart should glow.
boss_penjaga_mercusuar: A towering construct of smooth white stone like bone, lantern-shaped head with a dark empty glass chamber, massive arms, carved runes glowing faintly gold, gone feral.
pengawal_istana: An empty suit of gold-plated palace armor, ornate and ceremonial, moving on its own, fog seeping from the neck, a tall ceremonial halberd.
boss_baskara: An elegant middle-aged noble regent in dark batik robes and a gold headpiece, calm half-smile, holding a snuffed lantern, soft-spoken menace, never shouting.
boss_kelam_berwajah: A mass of living fog shaped into a vast face with many hollow eyes, tendrils forming arms, swallowing the light of the tower around it.
elang_badai: An eagle as big as a water buffalo, storm-grey feathers crackling with static, wings spread wide, wind streaks and dust around it.
kambing_batu: A mountain goat with horns of layered stone, craggy hide like cliff rock, planted hooves, stubborn glare, pebbles falling.
boss_garuda_kelabu: A garuda as big as a house, ancient grey feathers, gold-tipped wing edges, a proud crested head, talons gripping a cliff, guardian of the wind pass.
hantu_kafilah: The ghost of a caravan merchant, translucent, bent under a pack of phantom goods, fingers counting coins that are not there, ash swirling.
kalajengking_abu: A scorpion as long as an arm, exactly the color of grey ash, barely visible against dust, tail raised with a faintly glowing sting.
cacing_abu_muda: A young ash worm as long as a boat, segmented grey body bursting out of ash dunes, ring of teeth, dust pouring off its sides.
boss_cacing_abu_purba: A colossal ancient ash worm rising from the plain, body scarred with the ruins of burned towns, cavernous toothed maw, embers glowing inside.
burung_peniru: A small songbird with feathers of shifting colors, beak open mid-mimicry, eerie human-like eyes, surrounded by faint ghostly sound ripples.
pohon_gema: A tree whose bark is full of open mouths and hollows that echo songs, branches like outstretched arms, faint glowing sound rings in the air.
pendeta_ordo: A human priest of the Order of Pelita in white and gold robes, holding a small glass lantern, calm fanatic expression, clearly a living person.
boss_sunan_wirya: A charismatic preacher of the Order in layered white robes and a tall head wrap, one hand raised in sermon, a lantern staff in the other, sincere burning eyes.
warga_wirasaba: A citizen of a glass city living their last day on repeat: a translucent glassy figure sweeping a doorstep, eyes looking far away, waiting for someone.
boss_penjaga_suar_wirasaba: A three-person-tall construct of glass and bronze guarding a long-dead beacon, cracked glass chest with a cold empty core, heavy slow limbs.
cermin_berjalan: A person-tall standing mirror walking on its own on carved wooden feet, the reflection inside is someone else who is not the viewer.
konstruk_kaca: An empty suit of armor made of glass, built by the Order to guard a beacon; inside, something small and dark still moves slowly.
boss_kelana_berzirah: A hollow knight in heavy dark armor guarding a harvest cart of the Order, a great blade held low, no anger in its posture, only duty, fog behind the visor.
hampa_beku: A hollow figure frozen mid-step in the middle of a salt lake, ice and salt crystals growing on it, the fog around it frozen into jagged shapes.
kepiting_garam: A crab the size of a boat whose shell has turned into white salt crystal, walking sideways, claws crusted with salt, tiny glints.
boss_nyi_pandansari: A pragmatic lieutenant of the Order, a woman in practical dark armor and a hooded cloak, a large harvesting glass frame on her back glowing faintly, sharp tired eyes.
pemanen_ordo: An Order harvester with a glass cage-cart strapped to his back, captured faint lights inside, hooked pole in hand, speaking of liberation.
gerobak_kurungan: An Order harvest cart with glass cages full of faint captured lights, wheels that never stop turning, two harvesters chained to its sides.
pelita_hidup_muda: A young member of the Order halfway turned into light: skin cracking with bright glowing seams, eyes pure flame, ecstatic and afraid.
boss_nirmala: The leader of the Order of Pelita, an ageless woman in white robes with a crown of small glass flames, serene and certain, holding a tall beacon staff.
gema_pesta: A wedding feast remembered so loudly it stands on its own: floating plates, garlands, drums and laughing faint silhouettes, but no bride and groom.
gema_pengantin: A ghostly bride in traditional wedding attire and a jasmine veil, waiting at the end of a flower aisle that no longer exists, petals drifting.
gema_prajurit: A remembered war standing by itself: a rank of translucent soldiers with spears and shields fused into one marching mass.
nama_terbakar: A single name that was read aloud in a ritual and never finished: glowing burning letters forming a humanoid shape, smoke trailing.
penjaga_abad: An ancient guardian construct older than the Order, weathered stone with moss, a faded carved face, still obeying its first command.
boss_gema_guntur: Three memories of an old lantern-keeper mentor standing together as one figure: an elderly man with a white beard and a lantern staff, his silhouette repeated three times in different ages.
juru_nyala_padam: A ritual fire-keeper still tending a flame that went out long ago, in old ceremonial robes, holding tongs over cold ashes, devoted and lost.
boss_pelita_ketiga: A woman who entered the third beacon's glass chamber in the first century and is still waiting for her replacement: glowing, translucent, seated in a glass hollow, patient and tired.
gema_ordo: The first writers of the Order's rules, a group of pale robed figures holding one shared scroll, reading in the same voice, mouths moving together.
pelita_padam_kuno: An ancient Pelita lit before the Order existed: a tall figure of old faded golden light, crowned with a primitive clay lamp, calm and immense.
hampa_adiluhung: A citizen of the first city, eight centuries without a name: an elegant ancient hollow in ruined royal-court clothing, face smoothed away.
penjaga_suar_angin: An ancient beacon guardian construct of pale stone and bronze, one element only: wind, swirling air and leaves circling its body, a single glowing sigil.
penjaga_suar_api: An ancient beacon guardian construct of dark stone and bronze, one element only: fire, flames pouring from its joints, a single glowing sigil.
penjaga_suar_bumi: An ancient beacon guardian construct of heavy rock and bronze, one element only: earth, boulders orbiting it, cracked ground, a single glowing sigil.
penjaga_suar_cahaya: An ancient beacon guardian construct of white stone and gold, one element only: light, radiant beams from its chest, a single glowing sigil.
penjaga_suar_es: An ancient beacon guardian construct of blue stone and bronze, one element only: ice, frost and icicles on its limbs, a single glowing sigil.
penjaga_suar_kelam: An ancient beacon guardian construct of black stone and bronze, one element only: darkness, violet shadow leaking from its seams, a single glowing sigil.
penjaga_suar_petir: An ancient beacon guardian construct of grey stone and copper, one element only: lightning, arcs crackling between its horns, a single glowing sigil.
gema_party: A party of four young adventurers remembered by the fog: slightly younger, fearless, their shapes made of pale mist with bright confident eyes.
gema_penghitung: Something standing in the middle of a fog sea, counting: a tall thin figure with many fingers marking tallies in the air, faces of passers-by drifting around it.
kabut_gelombang: A tidal wave of fog flowing back toward a great well, carrying faint objects and faces inside it, curling crest.
boss_pelita_pertama: The first human ever burned into a light eight centuries ago, now the will of the Fog: a vast figure of dark fog with a burning human core, arms spread, crowned with smoke.
kabut_terakhir: All the fog in the world standing once in a shape that can be faced: an immense soft figure of mist with a sorrowful gentle face, asking to be sung, not killed.
penjaga_suar_kedelapan: A guardian construct built for an eighth beacon that never existed: incomplete, parts missing, a blank sigil, standing guard over nothing.
buruan_cacing_ibu: The mother of all ash worms, older than the burned cities: a titanic worm coiled beneath ash dunes, body like a mountain range, a maw like a city gate.
buruan_cacing_ibu_segmen: One segment of a titanic ash worm, large enough to fight on its own: a thick armored ring of grey flesh with legs and embers glowing between plates.
superboss_penenun: The Weaver who sits on the Lost Island rearranging everything that arrives: a figure made of countless threads and looms, many hands weaving, a shape impossible to describe from any angle.
